name: HeatBrief - temperature evidence and client briefing (MOCK)

nodes.name: Receive briefing request
nodes.notes: Attach a Header Auth credential: X-HeatBrief-Webhook-Key. POST examples/request.json.

nodes.name: Create and save briefing
nodes.notes: Attach Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer <HEATBRIEF_API_TOKEN>. Python validates, calls mock MCP, compares, generates and saves to SQLite. Adjust URL for container networking.

nodes.name: Prepare human review packet
nodes.notes: This is a review handoff. The automation has no reviewer credential and no sending node.

parameters.content:
## HeatBrief — MOCK DATA
Read docs/n8n-setup.md. Configure the two Header Auth credentials before execution.
The HTTP bridge uses real MCP stdio locally. FortyGuard live mode is unverified.
Reports and unsent follow-ups are saved in SQLite. Human review uses a separate token.
Workflow runtime import/execution must be verified in your n8n instance.
